title: 4-point bed tramming
intro: Probes the four reachable corners and tells, for each knob, how much to raise or lower the bed. The front-left corner is the reference: do not touch it.
noProbe: No probe (BLTouch, CR-Touch…) declared in the Klipper configuration: assisted tramming is unavailable.
noGeometry: Axis limits or probe offsets unreadable: check [stepper_x/y] and the probe section in printer.cfg.
bedLabel: Bed seen from above, front at the bottom
restartIn: Adjust the knobs: next pass in {seconds} s.
loop: Restart from the first point after {seconds} s until validated
blocked: Available when the machine is ready (not printing, paused or in error).
help: Heat the bed for an accurate result. Flatness is the gap between the highest and lowest corner; the bed mesh then compensates the rest.
confirmText: The head will home if needed, then probe the four corners. Keep your hands out of the head area during measurements; turn the knobs only during the countdown between passes.
confirmCheck: Bed clear, hands out of the motion area

errors.tramming-unavailable: Tramming unavailable: Moonraker does not respond or the probe is unreadable.
errors.tramming-state: The machine is not ready (printing, paused or Klipper not ready). Nothing sent.
errors.tramming-failed: Probing failed. Check the probe before retrying.
errors.tramming-sequence: Pass interrupted: restart from the first point.
errors.command-busy: Another operation is running on this machine.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
